Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X versions of Mewgenics are on the way this year, and we'll see both of them next month.

The new Mega Man Dual Override trailer showed a new boss, teased Protoman, and confirmed Pragmata will get skins based on the series.

The Onimusha: Way of the Sword demo is larger, thanks to an update that came up during gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live.

The Forbes Japan 30 under 30 for 2026 includes Hololive Vtuber Juufuutei Raden, Kagurabachi manga author Takeru Hokazono, and Babymetal.
